method: Complete 1-second contact-sheet visual review; live-ball candidate windows reviewed at 0.25 seconds; two ambiguous contact sequences additionally reviewed at 0.125 seconds. These are assistant-reviewed labels, not independently verified by a human coach.
definition: Visible live-ball field-goal attempts including blocked attempts; free throws excluded. Dead balls and non-shooting possessions are reviewed negatives.
